dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Progressive pure cerebellar ataxia, most consistent with a hereditary degenerative spinocerebellar ataxia (genetic subtype undetermined)

Alternative 1: Multiple-system atrophy, cerebellar type (MSA-C)

Alternative 2: Immune-mediated cerebellar ataxia, including gluten or anti-GAD-associated ataxia

Alternative 3: Paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration
